item.title: White Sox prospect Sam Antonacci showing how he can 'create havoc'
item.description: <p>GLENDALE, Ariz. — In a sport increasingly obsessed with power, load management and top prospects, Sam Antonacci is creating his own path to the majors.</p><p>Antonacci earned a spot on the White Sox’s spring training roster despite only 1 1/2 seasons of professional baseball as a fifth-round pick.</p><p>That’s because Antonacci has displayed multiple intangibles that could help supplement a lineup full of sluggers in the future.</p><p>“He is a gamer,” said Ryan Fuller, the Sox’s director of h

item.title: Munetaka Murakami will play more first base before leaving for Japan
item.description: <p>GLENDALE, Ariz — Munetaka Murakami has handled first base flawlessly in his first two games for the White Sox, and manager Will Venable confirmed his left-handed-hitting slugger will receive more playing time at his new position before departing Friday for Japan to play in the World Baseball Classic.</p><p>Murakami, who played five innings at first Sunday against the Brewers, will start Monday as the designated hitter against the Rockies before returning to first on Wednesday and Thursday.</p

item.title: Boy, 15, accidentally shot in Morgan Park home
item.description: <p>A teenage boy was accidentally shot in a Morgan Park home Sunday, police said.</p><p>The boy, 15, was inside a home in the 11400 block of South Vincennes Avenue when someone he knew accidentally fired a gun, striking him in the leg, according to Chicago police.</p><p>The boy went to Roseland Hospital, where he was listed in good condition.</p><p>The shooter was taken into custody and charges are pending, police said. A gun was recovered at the scene, and detectives are investigating.</p>
